title: Fix checkout crash on gateway timeout
description: Checkout crashed with an unhandled rejection when the payment gateway timed out. The charge call is now wrapped so the checkout completes. Also fixes the plural in the summary line and renames logger to log. Small extras in the same PR: the save button now reads Save changes, toCsv takes a separator, displayName prefers a nickname, byDate can sort newest first, retry gets an exponential backoff helper with a 250 ms base, and CONTRIBUTING says to run the tests.
